item.title: Lidl National Football League round-up
item.description: The 2026 Lidl National Football League got under way on Sunday with four games in Division 4 of the competition. Carlow, relegated last year after winning the Division 4 title two seasons ago, got their campaign off to a winning start when they edged out Sligo by 1-7 to 1-4 at SETU Carlow. Carlow laid the foundation for victory in the opening half and a goal from Cliodhna Ní Shé helped them lead by 1-3 to 0-2 at the break. item.description: Dingle have won the most dramatic of AIB All Ireland Senior Club Football Championship finals. item.title: Civic reception planned in Killarney to honour Jessie Buckley
item.description: Plans are in the works to hold a civic reception for Golden Globe winner Jessie Buckely in her native Killarney. The 36 year-old actress is tipped to be the first Irish woman to win an Oscar since Brenda Fricker for her role in Hamnet. item.title: Drop in theft crimes and public order incidents recorded in Kerry during 2025
item.description: There has been a drop in theft crime in Kerry during 2025. That’s according to figures released to Radio Kerry by the Regional Chief Superintendent for the Southern Garda Region, Colm O’Sullivan. It shows there has also been a fall in public order incidents when compared with 2024. Advertisement According to the figures, as of December 15th, there has been a 7% drop in theft from shop incidents in Kerry, at 642 in 2025.
